title: Represent Polygons on the Coordinate Plane
objective: I can draw polygons from their vertex coordinates on the coordinate plane, and use coordinates to find side lengths and solve perimeter and area problems.
model: polygon (mostly rectangles) drawn from vertex coordinates; side length from the shared coordinate, perimeter and area from the side lengths, scale applied last

widgets.replacement: Keep one copy as a set with a figure: viz {t:'coord', points:[{x:2,y:4,l:'A'},{x:5,y:4,l:'B'}], segments:[[0,1]]} and 'Two corners of a rectangular park are A(2, 4) and B(5, 4); 1 unit = 100 ft'. Ask width (300 ft), then length from area 240,000 sq ft (800 ft), then the scale back to units and the other two corners (2, −4), (5, −4). Use a different park (new numbers and unit scale) in §5 so mastery is not a repeat.

widgets.component: generated 'three vertices of rectangle ABCD are shown, which point is vertex C' and 'opposite corners P and Q' with a drawn plane
widgets.root: Two figure defects, measured over 300 seeds per level. (1) 'missing vertex' (L1 and L3, ~47% of draws): the generator joins the three shown points as segments [[0,1],[1,2]] in array order, but when the missing vertex is B or C the shown vertices are not consecutive, so one side is omitted and a diagonal is drawn (135 of 291 figures; e.g. A(4,5), B(6,5), D(4,8) joined B-to-D). (2) 'opposite corners P and Q' (L3, about half of L3 draws): the figure draws the whole rectangle and labels the plotted corners P, B, Q, D, so the two corners the student is asked to infer are given away and the labels (P, B, Q, D) do not match the stem or the A-B-C-D naming used everywhere else.
widgets.replacement: In assets/studio-gen/coordinate.js polygonCoordinates 'missing' (lv 1, 3): build the segments by vertex order (all[] neighbours i, i+1 mod 4) restricted to the shown vertices, so the figure shows two real sides at the right angle and never a diagonal; add a check to tools/studio-gen.test.mjs that every segment joins two points sharing x or y. In the L3 'opposite corners' item plot and label only P and Q (no outline, no B and D) or label all four A-D consistently with the stem.

widgets.component: Maria compares Space A 25 ft by 40 ft with Space B 30 ft by 30 ft
widgets.root: The stem says 'a grid where each unit is 1 foot and each grid line is 5 feet apart', which contradicts itself; no grid or coordinates are shown or used, so it is a rectangle-area comparison with no coordinate plane; and the second choice's '900 sq ft vs 850 sq ft' is not derived from anything in the stem.
widgets.replacement: Rebuild on a figure: viz {t:'coord'} with Space A the rectangle (0, 0), (5, 0), (5, 8), (0, 8) and Space B the square (7, 0), (13, 0), (13, 6), (7, 6), stem 'each grid unit is 5 feet'. Side lengths come from the coordinates (5, 8 and 6), area scales by 25: A = 1,000 sq ft, B = 900 sq ft. Choices trap: comparing perimeters instead of area, reporting grid-unit areas (40 and 36) as square feet, 'a square always beats a rectangle'. Delete the contradictory sentence and the 850 option.
